full_judgment: 7. Regarding the second question, the High Court Division found that section 19 of the Customs Act gave the Government general power to exempt any goods from customs duties whereas section 20 gave power to the Government to grant exception in exceptional circumstances i.e. in a special case of any particular importer as done was to the Corporation in the present case and the materials on record show that the Memo dated 8.8.1993 was issued on “বিশেষ বিবেচনায়” which means the existence of special circumstances and though the customs authority did not file any affidavit in opposition to state what was the special circumstances but the contents of the order sheet shows that the matter went up to the then Prime Minister for approval, and even the Cabinet Committee sat with the Corporation and therefore, although there is no elaborate recording of circumstances but the circumstances were definitely there and then order was passed exempting the tariff value on the goods imported by the Corporation.
